regime: Metals extend gains while tech futures slip
takeaway: Gold rose another 1.7% overnight to about $4,128, a two-week high, and silver about 1% to near $52.85, as the 10-year yield eased to about 4.87% and the dollar held flat. Oil steadied near $94 after Wednesday's plunge, while Nasdaq futures fell about 0.9% on weak chip earnings. Friday's jobs report is the next big test for yields and metals.
